author: Arnav
problem: Read a string S of 10 characters, where character i is 1 if bowling pin i is standing and 0 if it is knocked down. The pins form 7 columns, left to right: {7}, {4}, {2, 8}, {1, 5}, {3, 9}, {6}, {10}. Print Yes if pin 1 is down and there are two columns with a standing pin that have a column with every pin down between them; otherwise No.
bug_description: Compares S[0] with the integer 1 instead of the string "1", so the head-pin check never triggers and a standing pin 1 can still count as a split.

comments.accurate: Marks which columns still have a pin up and reports a split only when the head pin is down
comments.wrong_behavior: Marks which columns still have a pin up and reports a split from the column pattern alone
comments.wrong_location: Head-pin check verified; check the pin-to-column mapping for pins 5 and 9
